name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures an Nginx web server with three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, static content, redirects, security headers, rate limiting, logging, and host hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, log directory management, and a post-generation configuration workaround.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a Python FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub with a virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
